interpretation.decision: carry independent multibank memory forward as the multiscale reference; learned shared-slot timescales remain an ablation
interpretation.fixed_multiband: forcing decay bands without independent routing did not materially improve slow retention
interpretation.independent_multibank: separate write/read paths for fast-medium-slow banks materially improved long-state retention across three seeds
interpretation.per_slot_decay: learned slot decays clustered near 0.968-0.976 and did not recover slow state
interpretation.shared_decay: single shared decay favored fast state and largely forgot slow state
